en: The image is a sepia-toned historical illustration of a fortified castle complex with a prominent round tower, thick defensive walls, and a gate. There are mountains in the background and several groups of people in period clothing walking or gathering along a tree-lined road or square. The architecture on the right shows multi-story buildings with numerous windows, suggesting a European town. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and source of the image.
